description: Election Commission - Mr. T. Sendur Kumar of the Nawalapitiya Urban Council has Vacated his Office of member of that Urban Council
reasoning: This gazette notice announces that a member of the Nawalapitiya Urban Council has vacated their office, as declared by the Returning Officer under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. The content specifically deals with electoral processes and the status of an elected official, falling under the Elections category (Type 7) for matters related to electoral commissions, candidate registrations, and declarations about elected positions.
